goods.line: And Georgie Woods, The Guy with the Goods
stanza: Oh, would I could hear a radio here
James Brown singing 'I Lost Someone'
Or the Jesters
And the Paragons
And Georgie Woods, The Guy with the Goods
And Guided Missiles

hoods.line: Scatting round with their blue hoods
stanza: But no
I got nothing
No diversion
No window
Nothing here but a porthole in the plaster
In the plaster
Where I look down, look at Sweet Theresa's convent
All those nurses, all those nuns
Scatting round with their blue hoods
Like cats in mourning.

woods.line: I had a job in the great north woods
woods.lineNext: Working as a cook for a spell

woods.line: I could not work, so I threw a bottle into the woods
stanza: I could not work, so I threw a bottle into the woods
And then I felt bad for the doe paw and the rabbit paw
So I went looking for the pieces of the bottle that I threw
All because I couldn't work
I'm up in the woods
I'm down on my mind
I'm building a still
To slow down the time

woods.line: Not as a picture of the woods
stanza: I meant all my songs
Not as a picture of the woods
But just to remind myself
That I briefly live

woods.line: Choppity-chop goes the axe in the woods
stanza: Choppity-chop goes the axe in the woods
You gotta meet me by the fall down tree
Shovel full of dirt upon a coffee lid
And I know they'll come lookin' for me, boys
I know they'll come a-lookin' for me

woods.line: By the woods, by the woods, by the woods, by the woods
stanza: She was a January girl
She never let on how insane it was
In that tiny kinda scary house
By the woods, by the woods, by the woods, by the woods
By the woods, by the woods, by the woods, by the woods

woods.line: It's for my Granny in the woods
stanza: I wish—
It's not for me
It's for my Granny in the woods
A loaf of bread, please
To bring my poor old hungry
Granny in the woods...
Just a loaf of bread, please...

woods.line: Well, she was doing good 'til she went in the woods
stanza: Molly went to Arkansas
She got raped by Dobbin's dog
Well, she was doing good 'til she went in the woods
And got pinned up against a log

woods.line: And I grope through the woods
stanza: I creep through the valleys
And I grope through the woods
'Cause I know when I find it, my honey
It's gonna make me feel good, yes
I love everything
So don't it make you feel sad
'Cause I'll drink to you, my baby
I'll think to that, I'll think to that

woods.line: And the need for wailing in the woods
stanza: It's almost Mother's Day
Me and the other widows will commiserate
Alone at Montessori again
Straddling two worlds
Between the crush of single parenting
And the need for wailing in the woods
Around a slash pile burning
Into the night with tear crusted eyes

woods.songTitle: Any Moment / Moments in the Woods
woods.line: Anything can happen in the woods
stanza: Anything can happen in the woods
May I kiss you?
Any moment we could be crushed
